workspace.description: The workspace to list, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

name.description: The task's name, as the developer would name it in the sidebar.

repository.description: The GitHub repository its agents work in, as owner/name, which the workspace's GitHub installation must reach; null or left out for none, or the parent's where you give a parent.

brief.description: The developer's own words about the task, which Vespin is handed when they open a call on it; their words where they gave them, left out otherwise.

description.description: The description's body to start it with, as Markdown under its sections' ## headings, without the # title, which the task's name is; an agent started on it with no prompt is handed it. Left out, it starts empty.

status.description: Where the task stands: backlog for work filed for later; todo where left out.

priority.description: How much the task matters; none for a task no one has weighed yet.

assignee.description: The member the task is assigned to, who is on it now, by their mention link as list_tasks or another read names them, `[@Name](https://vespin.dev/<workspace>/person/<id>)`, or its address alone; a member of the task's workspace. null for no one.

parentTaskId.description: The task to make it a child of, by the id list_tasks answered: a part of that task's work, which works in its repository. Left out, it stands at the top.

kind.description: How the new task stands to the other, from the new task's side: blocked-by, it waits on the other's work; blocks, the other waits on its work; sub-task-of, a child of the other, as parentTaskId makes one; parent-of, the other's parent, refused where the other has a parent already.

taskId.description: The other task, of your workspace, by the id list_tasks answered.

relation.description: Another task of your workspace the new task starts related to, written with it so both land together. A sub-task-of or parent-of takes the other task's repository, so leave repository out, and another is refused; a block takes nothing of it. Not beside parentTaskId; left out, it starts related to none.
